command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "=== STEP 2: apply policy ==="
sudo -n cp /etc/security/pwquality.conf /etc/security/pwquality.conf.bak
sudo -n sed -i -E \
  -e 's/^#?\s*minlen\s*=.*/minlen = 12/' \
  -e 's/^#?\s*minclass\s*=.*/minclass = 3/' \
  /etc/security/pwquality.conf
grep -qE '^minlen\s*=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf || echo "minlen = 12" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf >/dev/null
grep -qE '^minclass\s*=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf || echo "minclass = 3" | sudo -n tee -a /etc/security/pwquality.conf >/dev/null
echo "=== resulting active settings ==="
grep -nE '^(minlen|minclass)\s*=' /etc/security/pwquality.conf
